title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
summary: OpenAI research shows enterprises are moving from AI assistance to autonomous execution, with agentic AI via ChatGPT and Codex leading adoption, and frontier firms gaining competitive advantage.
highlights: Enterprises are shifting from AI assistance to AI execution.
Agentic AI is being adopted through ChatGPT and Codex.
Frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.
